a-propos.title: About us
a-propos.content:
A passion for authentic flavours

Much more than a grocery store, Marché Chemin du Roy is a true culinary destination in the heart of Trois-Rivières. Since we opened, we have been committed to sharing the culinary riches of Quebec and Africa, creating a welcoming meeting place where cultural diversity comes through in our products.

Personal service

Our passionate, knowledgeable team welcomes you with a smile and guides you. We offer service tailored to each customer's needs, for a unique, attentive, quality experience.

Quality guaranteed

Because you deserve the best, we offer products carefully chosen for their quality and excellence.

Community and sharing

Our market celebrates the richness of African cultures and the local Quebec spirit. Through every product, we encourage sharing, closeness and support for the communities that keep our cultural richness alive.

What makes us unique

As well as being a convenience store, Marché Chemin du Roy stands out for its wide range of products:

Convenience store products

Beer, pet products, soft drinks, dairy products, chips, canned goods, refreshments, household products and more.

Market products

  • Fresh produce: plantains, yams, okra, assorted vegetables and more.
  • African products: traditional flours (fufu, gari), authentic spices, oils, condiments and more.
  • Frozen products: smoked fish, meat, bobolo, eru, placali, attiéké and more.
  • Hair products: braiding hair, wigs, weaves, crochet hair, hair accessories, hair care products and more.

Marché Chemin du Roy, your grocery store in Trois-Rivières!

conditions-generales.title: Terms and conditions
conditions-generales.content:
By using our website and placing an order, you fully and unreservedly accept these Terms and Conditions of Sale. Please read them carefully.

1. Orders and ordering process

Ordering process: selecting products and adding them to the cart does not constitute a firm order. An order is only considered final and accepted by Marché Chemin du Roy once a shipping confirmation email has been sent, except for orders placed through WhatsApp.

Accurate information: you are responsible for providing a correct and complete email address, delivery address and billing information.

Prices and availability: we make every effort to ensure the prices and availability shown are accurate. However, errors can occur. If an ordered product is unavailable or an incorrect price is found, we will let you know and offer either a refund or the cancellation of that item from your order.

2. Prices and payment

Currency: all prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD).

Taxes: prices shown are subject to the applicable Quebec sales taxes where required (GST and QST), which are added to your order's final total.

Payment methods: we accept the following payment methods on our website: credit/debit card (Visa, Mastercard).

Payment security: all transactions are secure and encrypted. Your credit card details are not stored on our servers.

3. Delivery

Delivery area: we currently deliver in the Trois-Rivières area. Delivery fees and times vary with your location and are shown (delivery fees) during checkout.

Delivery times: we process orders as quickly as possible. Orders are processed and shipped within 24 to 72 hours of the order. Deliveries are made Monday to Sunday during the selected time slots.

Receiving your order: you are responsible for making sure someone is available to receive the order. We call before every delivery. Orders are handed over in person; if no one is there, we bring the order back to the store so you can pick it up in store. Delivery fees are non-refundable. The risk of deterioration of perishable products passes to the customer once delivery has been attempted or made.

4. Return and refund policy

Because we mainly sell perishable food products, returns and refunds are generally not accepted, for hygiene and food safety reasons.

However:

If a product is unavailable, we will call you and, where appropriate, replace it with a similar item. Otherwise, we will refund it.

5. Data protection and privacy

We respect your privacy. All personal information you give us is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy, which we encourage you to read. We use your data only to process your order and improve your experience. We do not share your data with third parties for marketing purposes without your consent.

6. Intellectual property

All elements of the website (logos, text, graphics) are and remain the exclusive property of Marché Chemin du Roy or its licensors. Any reproduction or use without prior written permission is strictly prohibited.

7. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Marché Chemin du Roy is not liable for indirect or consequential damages resulting from the use of our products or our website.

8. Governing law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Quebec and of Canada. Any dispute about their interpretation or performance falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of the Province of Quebec.

9. Changes to these terms

Marché Chemin du Roy reserves the right to change these Terms and Conditions of Sale at any time. The terms that apply are those in effect on the date of your order.

10. Contact us

For any question about these Terms and Conditions, your order or our services, please contact us using the details on our website.

politique-de-confidentialite.title: Privacy policy
politique-de-confidentialite.content:
At Marché Chemin du Roy, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information.

1. Information we collect

We collect the following information:

  • Identification (first and last name)
  • Contact details (address, email, phone)
  • Payment information (processed securely)
  • Browsing data (IP address, cookies)
  • Order history

2. How we use your information

Your data is used to:

  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Send you order confirmations
  • Manage your customer account
  • Improve our services
  • Tell you about promotions (with your consent)

3. Sharing information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your data with:

  • Our delivery providers
  • Our payment processors
  • Legal authorities when required by law

4. Data retention

We keep your data for:

  • 3 years for inactive accounts
  • 10 years for accounting records (as required by law)
  • Until you unsubscribe, for marketing emails

5. Your rights

Under the GDPR and the Act respecting the protection of personal information, you have the right to:

  • Access your data
  • Correct your information
  • Delete your account
  • Object to processing
  • Data portability
  • Withdraw your consent

6. Cookies

Our website uses cookies to:

  • Improve your experience
  • Remember your preferences
  • Analyze site traffic
  • Personalize content

You can turn off cookies in your browser settings.

7. Security

We use technical and organizational security measures:

  • SSL encryption
  • Secure payments
  • Restricted access to data
  • Regular backups

8. Contact

For any question about this policy or your data:
Marché Chemin du Roy
65 Rue Notre-Dame E, Trois-Rivières
+1 819-372-9966

9. Changes

We reserve the right to change this policy. Changes will be posted on our website.

Thank you for your trust.

politique-de-remboursement-et-de-retour.title: Refund and return policy
politique-de-remboursement-et-de-retour.content:
At Marché Chemin du Roy, we are committed to offering you top-quality products. Please read our return and refund policy carefully.

1. General policy for food products

Because our products are perishable, we generally do not accept returns or give refunds for food products, except in the exceptional cases described below.

2. Accepted exceptions

Any return or refund is handled in store.

We accept returns and give refunds in the following situations:

Spoiled or damaged product:

  • Expiry date passed at the time of delivery

Our mistake:

  • Wrong product delivered
  • Product unavailable

3. Claim deadline

Any claim must be made within 24 hours of receiving your order.

4. Return procedure

To report a problem:

  • Call us at +1 819-372-9966 or come to the store
  • Provide proof: bring us the item and explain the problem.

5. Refunds

Refunds are processed within 5 to 10 business days:

  • To the original payment method
  • For the amount of the products concerned
  • Less delivery fees, if applicable

6. Customer service

For any question about returns:
Marché Chemin du Roy
65 Rue Notre-Dame E, Trois-Rivières
+1 819-372-9966

Store hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.; Sunday, 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

7. Exclusions

This policy does not cover:

  • Change of mind
  • In-store purchases
  • Opened or partly consumed products
  • Damage caused by improper storage by the customer

We reserve the right to assess each case individually and to make the final decision on any return or refund.
